A message demanding a huge ransom has been received from a mystery alien race, inhabiting a hitherto unexplored planet, DRAGONIA-6809.

His niece, "Shipley", a chip off the old block, and having just obtained her pilot's license, decides to head off to teach those nasty aliens a lesson!

Navigate Shipley's craft, the INTERCEPTOR 010, throughout cavern after cavern - avoid contact with aliens - blast crates to reveal bounty. Within them, some contain treasure, adding to your score, while others increase firepower).

Time your moves to dodge forcefields, and be wary of rockets that launch at you. Your weapons are a laser which will destroy rockets, crates and certain aliens. You also have a bouncing bomb that will annihilate everything in it's path.

You have 5 ships to begin with. An extra craft is awarded on completion of each level.

219464.overview:
Ringo is a logical platformer made in experimental graphic mode and inspired by classic arcade games.

You play as a young Snoogle named Ringo who needs to find as many magic stars as possible in the underground labyrinths of the twilight land.

The fact is that the Snoogles use the stars to illuminate their homes during the long winter evenings. And as you know, even a cup of hot lingonberry tea is no fun in total darkness!

417857.overview:
Your right of passage to adulthood has arrived!

You are NYM. Your last day of childhood has arrived and as tradition dictates, you must undergo a rite of passage. You must cross the Rubicon maze. A fiendish labyrinth that will test your abilities. Find the five Scrolls of Knowledge. Find the three Crowns of Wealth. Find the Ring of Argus. Find the Amulet of Light so that you can pass the gatekeeper and find your true love. 

Originally published for free by the game's own developers, an enhanced version was published by Bitmap Soft in 2020.

419888.overview: Protect R2 and destroy 'D. Vader' in this reaction game where you need to select the correct spoke that Vader will appear in.

425761.overview:
You have been imprisoned in a maze by the Rondure Sorcerer who enjoys playing with the fate of mortals like yourself. You must navigate through fourteen levels to find your freedom.
Each level contains guards which you must either defeat or avoid.
Treasure chests contain gold and items which may help you.
The Maze Sprite will assist you provided you do not attack her.
You must escape from each level by finding the exit marked X on
the map.  You will begin each level armed with only your trusty dagger.

449976.overview: A text adventure created using the Professional Adventure Writer by Peter Clark and published by The Adventure Workshop in 1995. In it you engage in an archaeological treasure hunt. A previously undiscovered tomb may have been opened in the Valley of the Kings. The newspaper is prepared to send someone to an archaeologists' convention. This person should meet with an Interpol agent in the Milton Hotel in Cairo. You receive a letter of identification and a plane ticket for Cairo.

451154.overview:
A compilation of three illustrated text horror games by Rod Pike:

Dracula
Frankenstein
Wolfman

452040.overview:
Not to be confused with the Mastertronic Plus/EDOS game of the same name, the Arctic Computing game, which has the same name, was released three years prior.

Like the Mastertroic Plus game, this game is also a rugby management simulation for 1 player. This game is a bit more bare-bones than the 1989 game as well.

The game was also re-released by Tynesoft Computer Software.

454114.overview:
You have just purchased a brand new Dora la Aspiradora model Rumba, the latest in its category, with two cleaning modes, vacuuming and mopping. The store assured you that it was the best vacuum cleaner, capable of cleaning a room in a high percentage in a short time and with few resources. And it comes with a guarantee that if it doesn't do its job, it can be returned to the store. Just what you need in your home, since your little dog named Chica leaves every room a mess. 

Your duty as a young, novice vacuum cleaner is to clean the rooms in the factory-set time and prove that you didn't make a mistake with your purchase. But Chica won't make it easy...

454168.overview:
The command robots of Snowball have found the colonisable planet Eden, and already set about colonising this lush, verdant planet. Not easy, though - native plants and animals have adapted and fought back at the threat to their territory. A walled area now encloses the city, which is crumbling around you.

When Snowball 9 reaches the planet, Commander Kim Kimberley is filmed apparently committing a murder. As Kim, you must escape from the 'justice' of crazed robot droids. Snowball 9's landing is made dangerous due to the robots malfunctioning.

Return to Eden is an interactive fiction game which sets you as Kim, and challenges you to enter and survive within the robot city. Strange and surreal outcomes about - what do you get when you plant a brick? The world includes a bank, a theme park, the Corridors of Power, and a Starbike.

Unlike its predecessor, it features graphics, with over 200 illustrative pictures featured adds the ability to type while the screen is updating. Vocabulary is simplified - a new IT command refers to the last-mentioned object, and clothing can be WEAR'ed without being GET'ted first.

460899.overview:
Centuries ago, Beardopolis stood as the bastion of an ancient order of painter-knights. But after the fall of the last Grand Brushmaster (following the events of Bearded Fantasy), the fortress was plunged into the grayness of abandonment.

Now, the last heir to that tradition, Sir Paintalot, has returned—determined to restore the castle’s former glory.

But his task won’t be easy: when the castle was deserted, a magical rift opened deep within its dungeons, drawing in monsters, shadows, and enemies that loathe all things living, fresh, and… green. These invaders see paint as a symbol of the ancient power that once kept them at bay—so they will stop at nothing to sabotage his mission.

462364.overview: This is a rare promo edition of Rock Star Ate My Hamster. The Sun newspaper ran a contest and 10 runner-ups were given this promo version of the game for either the ZX Spectrum, the Commodore 64, or the Amistrad CPC. This edition includes 7 additional stars, with Kylie Minogue renamed as Koily Mynose instead of Bimbo Baggins.

462375.overview:
Rygar returns with improved background graphics and new loading screen in this 2019 version, and as you might remember the original game recycled the levels from level 14-27. This version does not so you have completed the game after finishing level 13. This mod is a New Year gift to the Spectrum community from Rafal Miazga (Thank you Ralf!) and it can be downloaded here: https://www.sendspace.com/file/w5nnpn

List of changes:

    New graphics and levels (some stuff like enemy patterns and powerup positions were left unchanged)


    New player sprite


    New loading screen, inspired by the inlay


    New font, taken from the arcade version


    Adjusted powerup graphics in the menu, in the original version the graphics were

inverted

    Adjusted intro text. Now it's the same as in the arcade version. In the

original Spectrum version it was a little bit corrupted

    Adjusted LETS FIGHT to LET'S FIGHT


    Corrected original bug/design error. When you completed the game, after congratulations

message you were taken directly to the menu and couldn't type your name into hiscore table.
You could type your name into hiscore only if you lost all your lives. Now you go into
hiscore after completing the game.

    The game is shorter now, only 13 levels. Perfect for a quick go  In the original version

the levels repeated after 13th level so they were going from easy to hard and them suddenly
becoming easy again. Now nothing repeats and there is a kind of final level.

462984.overview: For years, the soldier of the star alliance Orion Kane has been trained in boarding and rescue missions.An expert not only in weapons but also in hacking and repairing electronic equipment, he has been requested by the high command for a new mission.From Fort Bragg, he departs for his next destination with the light Mark VII ship, heading towards one of the enemy star corvettes of the Scipio model, used for transporting troops, supplies, and prisoners.

463000.overview: A text adventure by Larry Horsfield. Run, Bronwynn, Run was originally published by FSF Adventures and later rereleased by Adventure Probe Software.

463015.overview:
Get ready for Master Roshi’s toughest — and funniest — training session! In Roshi Milk Course for the ZX Spectrum, you take control of Krilin, the small but brave disciple from Kame Island, on his mission to deliver milk… and survive the process!

Run, jump, and dodge hazards while collecting five milk bottles scattered across each stage. Once you’ve gathered them all, you’ll move on to the next level of training. But be careful: the world is filled with enemies like Pilaf and his henchmen, deadly spikes, and bosses ready to test your reflexes and endurance.

Prove yourself worthy of the Turtle School symbol by reaching the highest score. Earn bonus points for completing levels quickly or finishing with extra lives.

With colorful graphics, classic arcade-style action, and that unmistakable Dragon Ball humor, Roshi Milk Course is a true 8-bit gem — proof that even delivering milk can be legendary training.

464133.overview: The objective is to control a nuclear reactor by moving a control unit in such a way that the metal elements bounce from it at right angles and hit the central discharge unit, a tricky manoeuvre until you get used to it.  Each time you accomplish it successfully, the power of the reactor increases and radiation is kept under control.

471030.overview:
Retro Robbins, our 8-bit superhero and part-time fearless assassin, is on an urgent mission. 
Armed with his trusty flat-cap and insatiable appetite for all things retro,
he must now frantically search for new and interesting items to make his next YouTube channel the best!
As luck would have it, everyone at Crash Towers has gone away on holiday, giving him the chance to 
sneak in and use his ninja-like skills to nab as many retro gems as possible!

476180.overview:
The setting is Rome in the 1st Century B.C. You are Emperor and your objective is to conquer the 6 countries which are hostile to you at the beginning of the game. In order to conquer a country, you must wipe out their troops. To enable you to do this, at the outset of the gamo you have 5 GENERALS, each in command of an army (signified by a flag) which does not initially contain any troops. You have also 10 LEGIONS (signified by an eagle) each consisting of 5,000 men.

The idea of the game is to build up some or all of the armies from the various legions and launch campaigns in the appropriate countries.
